tasks.label: super-admin security build-check
tasks.command: bash -lc 'set -e; if [ -d "my-backend" ]; then echo "Backend exists"; fi; if [ -d "my-frontend" ]; then cd my-frontend && jq -r .name package.json >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; echo "Frontend exists"; fi; echo DONE'

tasks.label: temp-build-and-push-precheck
tasks.command: bash -lc 'set -e; echo "Node: $(node -v 2>/dev/null || echo missing)"; echo "NPM: $(npm -v 2>/dev/null || echo missing)"; git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "Git repo: yes" || echo "Git repo: no"; echo DONE'

tasks.label: local env precheck
tasks.command: bash -lc 'set -e; echo "Backend .env.local.example:"; sed -n "1,80p" my-backend/.env.local.example 2>/dev/null || echo missing; echo; echo "Frontend .env.local.example:"; sed -n "1,80p" my-frontend/.env.local.example 2>/dev/null || echo missing; echo; echo DONE'

tasks.label: start backend (dev)
tasks.command: bash -lc 'set -e; cp -n my-backend/.env.local.example my-backend/.env.local || true; (cd my-backend && PORT=5000 NODE_ENV=development node index.js)'

tasks.label: smoke test login /api/auth/login
tasks.command: bash -lc 'set -e; curl -sS -i -X POST http://localhost:5000/api/auth/login -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data '{"email":"demo_hub_incharge@bisman.demo","password":"Demo@123"}' | sed -n "1,20p"'

tasks.label: restart backend (dev)
tasks.command: bash -lc 'pkill -f "node index.js" || true; sleep 0.5; (cd my-backend && PORT=5000 NODE_ENV=development node index.js)'

tasks.label: curl login after start
tasks.command: bash -lc 'sleep 1; curl -sS -i -X POST http://localhost:5000/api/auth/login -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data '{"email":"demo_hub_incharge@bisman.demo","password":"Demo@123"}' | sed -n "1,200p"'

tasks.label: frontend dev start
tasks.command: bash -lc 'set -e; cp -n my-frontend/.env.local.example my-frontend/.env.local || true; (cd my-frontend && npm run -s dev &>/dev/null &) && sleep 2; echo STARTED'

tasks.label: cleanup-temp-files
tasks.command: rm -f check-role-pages.js check-railway.js fix-railway-roles.js && echo 'Cleaned up!'

tasks.label: git-push
tasks.command: git status && git add -A && git commit -m 'fix: update chat/AI routes and tasks config' && git push origin deployment
